INFORMATION ITEM
ORANGE COUNTY PUBLIC SCHOOLS
SICK LEAVE BANK ENROLLMENT/WITHDRAWAL FORM

Name

S.S.#

School or Dept.
Position

Home Address
(Street)

(State)
(Zip)

Date
Home Phone

ENROLLMENT ( )
I hereby request that I be enrolled as an active member of the Sick Leave Bank. I understand that I must initially contribute one day of sick leave and may be asked to make future contributions at such time(s) as the Bank's available sick leave reaches 300 days. I further understand that membership is voluntary and that donated days will not be returned except as provided for in the Sick Leave Bank program.*

TERMINATION ( )
I hereby request that my membership in the Sick Leave Bank be terminated.

(Signature)

*For additional information on the Sick Leave Bank refer to Article XIX K. of the Contract between the School Board of Orange County and the Classroom Teachers Association, or contact your Work Location Supervisor.
